scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,sim,cos --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:sim" "pnpm run dev:cos"
scripts.dev:sim: PORT=5173 BASE_PATH=/ API_PORT=3001 COS_PORT=5174 pnpm --filter @workspace/incident-simulator run dev
scripts.dev:cos: PORT=5174 BASE_PATH=/cos-simulator/ API_PORT=3001 pnpm --filter @workspace/cos-simulator run dev
